summary: Attempt c establishes compatible pre-transaction workload and device-model context, plus a valid early trigger, but it failed the source-allocation zero-queue identity gate before source release. No v11 reclamation, useful-capacity, SLO-restoration, restore, movement-amplification, or temporary-memory result exists. Therefore no decisive v10-v11 delta is scientifically calculable.

valid_contextual_matches.qualification: The exact device model and count match; this does not by itself prove the same interconnect placement.
Attempt-c readiness directly persisted vLLM 0.23.0; this contextual match cannot rescue the failed transaction.
Agent 10 established the v11 values through exact pre-failure runtime-topology validation. They describe the source topology, not a completed preservation transaction.

valid_contextual_matches.v10: 12 rps stable guard, 15 rps overload point, 8-10 rps control/restore-period load
valid_contextual_matches.v11_attempt_c: 12 rps guard PASS, 15 rps guard PASS, exact five-second 9 rps control interval PASS, 15 rps transaction spike
valid_contextual_matches.qualification: Only pre-failure methodology is comparable; no post-reclamation service recovery occurred.

topology_caveat.v10_evidence: Two A100-SXM4-80GB devices, bidirectional peer read/write access, and 12 active NVLink links per GPU were persisted; nvidia-smi topo -m itself failed, so host PCI/CPU/NUMA placement was unavailable.
topology_caveat.v11_attempt_c_evidence: Two stable, distinct A100-SXM4-80GB UUIDs were persisted before and after the invocation, but attempt c did not persist an equivalent peer-access/NVLink/topology matrix.
topology_caveat.consequence: Exact device-name matching is adequate context, not proof of identical GPU-to-GPU or host interconnect placement. Even if the v11 transaction had completed, cross-run stage timing claims would require this caveat or within-run decomposition. Since it did not complete, no causal timing claim is permitted in any case.

valid_non_decisive_observations.causal_comparison_limit: The immutable v10 result set supplies no matched trigger-backlog or controller-reaction value, so no v10-v11 delta is computed.
This confirms like-sized source state, but does not establish any completed v11 movement or latency result.

valid_non_decisive_observations.value: 12 rps PASS; 15 rps overload PASS; five-second 9 rps control PASS
valid_non_decisive_observations.causal_comparison_limit: These are sanity and control gates, not replacements for the missing reclamation and recovery endpoints.

hbm_reclamation_seconds.reason: Source release and HBM reclamation did not execute.

first_useful_gpu1_capacity_seconds.reason: GPU1 never became useful for serving after the trigger.

serving_slo_restoration_seconds.reason: There was no two-GPU recovery, queue drain, or accepted five-second SLO window.

rollout_first_resumed_token_seconds.reason: Restore and branch resumption did not execute.

rollout_continuation_complete_seconds.reason: No continuation tokens were produced after restore because restore did not execute.

full_physical_amplification.reason: No completed integrated StatePassRecord ledger or movement summary was published.

peak_host_temporary_bytes.reason: No completed integrated transaction published an attributable temporary-memory peak.

reasons: The micro-validation was an isolated state-path experiment, not the serving-overload, reclamation, recovery, and restore transaction that defines the integrated endpoints.
The micro-validation used an A100-80GB PCIe device while attempt c and frozen v10 used two A100-SXM4-80GB devices; mixing those wall timings would confound topology and scope.
Micro export and restore wall times are not anchored to the integrated RECLAIM_TRIGGER, useful-capacity, stable-SLO, or first-resumed-token endpoints.
Micro StatePassRecords cannot substitute for the missing canonical integrated pass ledger; attempt-c export records were transient and not persisted after the fail-closed exception.
The micro 21.000762818351625x full, 2.000257098485553x external, and 12.000762818351625x avoidable amplification values describe the micro transaction only.
The micro 143552512-byte peak host temporary-memory value is not an integrated peak under concurrent serving and restore.

existing_comparison_artifact_assessment.assessment: The artifact correctly preserves the seven immutable v10 values, leaves every v11 value and delta null, marks the comparison scientifically invalid, and explicitly forbids micro substitution.
